name: Hunyuan3D-2mv
description: Multi-view to 3D mesh generation using Hunyuan3D-2mv. Takes a tiled image of orthographic views (up to 6: front, left, back, right, top, bottom) and outputs a 3D GLB mesh. Texture is a separate node.
author: iammojogo

params_schema.label: Quality Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Number of shape-generation diffusion steps. Lower = faster (5-10 is turbo territory). Higher = slower but potentially better quality (30 is the standard high-quality setting).

params_schema.label: Input Views
params_schema.tooltip: How many views to use for shape generation (1-6). The bridge auto-detects the grid layout from the image aspect ratio (2x2 for ≤4, 2x3 or 3x2 for 5-6). Reading order: [front, left, back, right, top, bottom].

params_schema.label: Mesh Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Marching-cubes grid resolution — directly sets face count. Lower = coarser/blockier mesh with fewer faces (and less VRAM). 32 gives ~7-8k faces, ideal for low-end meshes.

params_schema.label: Dual Guidance
params_schema.tooltip: Dual-guidance CFG runs 3 forward passes per step on 6GB. Turn off for speed.

params_schema.label: Image Input Mode
params_schema.tooltip: How to interpret the wired image. 'Single' uses the whole image as one view. 'Tiled' splits a pre-made grid (auto-detects 2x2/2x3/3x2 from aspect ratio). 'Folder' reads images from the folder path below.

params_schema.label: Image Folder
params_schema.tooltip: Only used when Input Mode = 'Image Folder'. Path to a folder of images to auto-tile into a 2x2 grid.

nodes.name: Texture Mesh
nodes.description: Hunyuan3D-2.0 paint pipeline. Takes an input mesh plus reference image(s) you wire in, and textures it via multiview diffusion + bake + inpaint. Inpaint is always on (fills UV gaps that would otherwise leave the mesh black).

params_schema.label: Decimate Faces
params_schema.tooltip: Decimate the mesh to ~N triangles before the paint pipeline's UV-unwrap. Lower = faster/less VRAM.

params_schema.label: Texture Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Resolution of the baked UV texture atlas. Higher = sharper textures but more VRAM and slower bake. 2048 pairs well with the dense UV packing.

params_schema.label: Reference Images
params_schema.tooltip: How many reference images to feed the texture diffusion. 1 = use the whole image as a single reference. 2-6 = split the tiled image in reading order, auto-detecting 2x2/2x3/3x2 grid from aspect ratio.

params_schema.label: Delight (Lighting Normalize)
params_schema.tooltip: Delight re-renders the subject under canonical lighting. Off by default — it often washes out real colors and detail. Turn On only if your reference has strong shadows/highlights that hurt the texture.

params_schema.label: Texture Diffusion Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Number of multiview diffusion steps for texture generation. Lower = faster but less refined. Higher = slower but potentially sharper. 30 is the stock default.

params_schema.label: Image Input Mode
params_schema.tooltip: How to interpret the wired conditioning image. 'Single' uses the whole image as one reference. 'Tiled' splits a pre-made grid (auto-detects 2x2/2x3/3x2 from aspect ratio). 'Folder' reads images from the folder path below.

params_schema.label: Image Folder
params_schema.tooltip: Only used when Input Mode = 'Image Folder'. Path to a folder of images to auto-tile into a 2x2 grid.

params_schema.label: Texture Method

options.label: Hybrid (diffusion geometry + full-res refs via optical flow)
Deform (warp reference views to mesh, full res)

params_schema.tooltip: How to generate the texture views that get baked onto the mesh. 'Diffusion' runs Hunyuan3D-2 multiview diffusion (learns how the reference fits the mesh geometry, but capped at 512px per view). 'Hybrid' runs the same diffusion to learn the geometry, then warps each full-res reference onto that geometry with dense optical flow — full reference resolution with correct mesh fit. 'Deform' skips diffusion entirely: it warps each wired reference view so its silhouette matches the mesh's rendered silhouette at the same camera angle (silhouette warp handles scale/offset, not radical shape changes).

nodes.name: Apply Texture
nodes.description: Maps an upscaled UV texture atlas (PNG/JPG) onto a mesh that already has UV coordinates. No diffusion, no bake — just applies the image to the existing UVs and exports GLB. Use this to feed a super-resolved atlas from an external upscaler back onto the original mesh.
